title: Non-enzymatic posttranslational protein modifications in protein aggregation and neurodegenerative diseases
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,129-149
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00221K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tim Baldensperger, Miriam Preissler, Christian F. W. Becker
In this review we summarize the known non-enzymatic posttranslational modifications (nPTMs) of proteins involved in neurodegeneration and discuss illustrative examples of such nPTMs studied using sophisticated protein engineering approaches.
